shortDescription: Vietnamese tungsten producer Masan High-Tech Materials Corp said on Thursday it will sell a 4.99% stake to US-based tungsten products supplier Elmet Group NASDAQ:ELMT.Masan High-Tech also said it will sign a tungsten supply deal with Elmet worth an estimated $1.5 billion for at least eight years.
